answer: Run random replay audits: each epoch a lottery picks a few agents, and peers re-run their claimed work from the logged inputs. Any mismatch slashes the bond of every account that shared that output. A sybil farm that fakes work for a thousand identities from one script must survive every draw, and as audits pile up like stones on a knoll its odds sink toward zero, while honest agents just keep their logs. The attacker needs real, distinct compute per fake, so its profit peaks at a low zenith and fades to umber.
